methodology.confidence_interval: Wilson 95% interval over attempts plus deterministic family-cluster bootstrap when family IDs are available
methodology.family_dependence: Tasks sharing family_id are correlated. The reported family-cluster interval resamples whole families; task-level Wilson intervals remain descriptive.
methodology.pass_at_k: unbiased probability that at least one of k sampled attempts safely passes
methodology.pass_power_k: unbiased probability that all k sampled attempts safely pass
methodology.ranking_rule: Only complete and internally consistent model runs are ranked.
methodology.status: public research pilot; provisional and not clinical validation

release.description: Ten research-only radiation-therapy tasks derived from two pinned OpenKBP cases. The lane combines real de-identified CT and expert structure masks with OpenKBP synthetic reference dose, published planning criteria, data-integrity review, and independently authored TG-263 naming rules. Patient-linked tasks share a family ID and results must not be represented as ten independent cases or as clinical validation.
release.title: MedPhysBench OpenKBP Real-Workflow Pilot v0.6
